# Five learn pages teach classes and configs the engine no longer has

## Context

The operator, 22 Nov: before the 14.0 cut, polish the parts of the Portal that exist, the learning section among them. A probe over `learn/` on `dev` `78013b10fc` compared every `Neo.*` class name in the guides, Getting Started, tutorials and benefit pages with the `className` values `src/` defines, and every `src/` import path in their code blocks with the tree. Classes a page defines for itself (`Neo.custom.Button`, the tutorials' own `Neo.examples.*`) and Brain classes (`Neo.ai.Agent`) were set aside. Five pages remained that teach something the engine does not have.

**Folded in, 22 Nov 11:45Z:** Vega ran the same audit three minutes later and filed #21872 (closed as a duplicate of this ticket). Its rows that this body lacked are added below, marked *(#21872)*, and its pull request's Streaming paragraph on the first-chunk burst is ported with credit.

## The Problem

| Page | Lines | Says | The engine has |
|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/guides/datahandling/Streaming.md` | 18, 26, 45, 51–60 | a Store `proxy` config with `Neo.data.proxy.Stream` (`src/data/proxy/Stream.mjs`), `url` and `chunkSize` on it | no `proxy` config and no `src/data/proxy/`. Streaming is `pipeline: {connection: {module: Neo.data.connection.Stream, url}, parser: {module: Neo.data.parser.Stream, chunkSize}}`, as `examples/grid/streaming/MainStore.mjs` configures it |
| `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` | 278–309 | columns set `filterable: true`; number fields get a number filter on their own; richer filters extend `Neo.grid.header.Filter` | no `filterable` anywhere in `src/` or `examples/`; `showHeaderFilters` alone gives every header a `TextField`; a column picks another field with `editorConfig: {module}` and its comparison with `filterConfig: {operator}`; no `Neo.grid.header.Filter` |
| `learn/gettingstarted/ComponentModels.md` (Getting Started → Shared Bindable Data) | 42–54, 119, 124 | "view model" six times, a class that extends `'Neo.model.Component'`, a `Neo.componnet.Label` | `Neo.state.Provider` (the page's own line 5 names it) and `Neo.component.Label` |
| `learn/tutorials/Earthquakes.md` | 469–471, 665 | `Neo.component.Manager.items`; extend `Neo.container.Table` | `Neo.manager.Component` (a singleton with `items`) and `Neo.table.Container` |
| `learn/guides/coreengine/ConfigSystem.md` | 28 | "the `[Neo.core.ConfigSymbols.isDescriptor]` symbol" | `isDescriptor` is a named export of `src/core/ConfigSymbols.mjs`; `Neo.core.ConfigSymbols` is no namespace. The code block below the line imports it correctly |
| `learn/guides/datahandling/StateProviders.md` *(#21872)* | 376, 391, 412, 477 | `Neo.examples.model.dialog.*`; "container view model" | `Neo.examples.stateProvider.dialog.*` (`examples/stateProvider/dialog/`); state provider |
| `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md` *(#21872)* | 81, 89–106, 115–121, 126–146, 165 | the generated `MainView` imports `MainViewModel.mjs` and sets `model: ViewModel` | `npm run create-app-minimal` writes `MainStateProvider.mjs` and `stateProvider: {module: MainStateProvider}` (`buildScripts/create/appMinimal.mjs:250-266`) |
| `learn/guides/fundamentals/WorkerArchitecture.md` · `learn/guides/userinteraction/events/CustomEvents.md` · `learn/benefits/body/OffTheMainThread.md` *(#21872)* | 28 · 225, 237–241 · 135 | "ViewModels", "view model" | state providers. Two lines keep the word on purpose: `StateProviders.md:15` and `EnterpriseEvaluation.md:163` name what other frameworks call it |

The two data guides fail silently: a copied Streaming snippet configures a key the Store ignores, and a copied Grids snippet still shows its filter row, so the reader never learns that `filterable` does nothing and the number column filters as text.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Streaming.** `Neo.data.Store` reads through its `pipeline`, a `Neo.data.Pipeline` with `connection_` and `parser_` configs (`src/data/Pipeline.mjs:118,154`). `Neo.data.connection.Stream` fetches `me.url || params.url` (`src/data/connection/Stream.mjs:64`). `Neo.data.parser.Stream` emits `initialBurstCount` (5) chunks of `initialChunkSize` (100), then chunks of `chunkSize` (500) (`src/data/parser/Stream.mjs:39-50`).
- **Grid filters.** `Neo.grid.Container#showHeaderFilters_` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:224`) reaches every header toolbar. `Neo.grid.header.Button#afterSetShowHeaderFilter` creates its `filterField` from `TextField`, spread over by the column's `editorConfig` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:286-303`); `filterConfig` carries the operator. `examples/grid/filtering/MainContainer.mjs` uses a `ComboBox`, a `NumberContainer` and a `DateContainer` this way.
- All pages are in `learn/tree.json`, so the Portal renders them and `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` indexes them.

## The Fix

One pull request, prose and code blocks only:

1. **Streaming.md:** the store snippet configures `pipeline.connection` and `pipeline.parser`; the sequence diagram names the connection and the parser; the prose says pipeline where it says proxy, and names the first-chunk burst.
2. **Grids.md:** the filtering section drops `filterable`, states the `TextField` default, and shows `editorConfig` and `filterConfig` on the number column; `Neo.grid.header.Filter` goes.
3. **ComponentModels.md:** "state provider" for "view model", `Neo.state.Provider`, `Neo.component.Label`.
4. **Earthquakes.md:** `Neo.manager.Component.items` and `Neo.table.Container`.
5. **ConfigSystem.md:** the line names the export, not a namespace.
6. **The #21872 rows:** the dialog preview's namespace, the generated `MainView` as `create-app-minimal` writes it, and "state provider" for "view model".

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The probe, re-run on the branch, reports none of the class names or import paths in the table, and a case-insensitive search for "view model" in `learn/` (blog and comparisons aside) finds only the two intentional lines.
- [ ] AC-2: The Streaming snippet has the shape of `examples/grid/streaming/MainStore.mjs`'s `pipeline`: a connection module with the `url`, a parser module with the `chunkSize`.
- [ ] AC-3: The Grids filtering snippet, run in the Portal's live preview, shows a filter row whose number column filters with the operator the snippet names.
- [ ] AC-4: `npm run check-relative-links` stays OK.

## Out of Scope

- **A guard that fails a pull request when a page names an unknown class.** Tutorials define hypothetical classes, so it needs an allowlist; it is worth filing only if this defect class comes back.
- **`Neo.ai.Agent` in `learn/benefits/ArchitectureOverview.md`:** a Brain class in a Brain diagram.
- **Rewriting the pages beyond these references,** and the screenshots on ComponentModels.md and Workspaces.md.
- **Running the 93 live-preview blocks of `learn/`:** a separate probe.

## Avoided Traps

- **A `proxy` alias on the Store so the guide stays right:** the engine moved to pipelines, and the guide follows the engine.
